g.text: Medallion Data Lake & Scientometric Research Intelligence Platform • Systematic Literature Review on Distribution System Planning

• Formulations: MILP • MISOCP • MINLP • Heuristics • AI/RL

Authoritative CSV metadata + paginated .bib + bulk PDF packages

Automated cited-by counts, reference arrays & venue normalization
• 1,831 Curated Articles after canonical DOI deduplication and non-article screening
• 6,235 RAG Text Chunks (Abstracts & full-text sections with SHA-256 hash preservation)
• Audit Provenance: Execution duration, status, and summary metrics in lit_pipeline_runs
• Normalized DOI Canonical Keying (strips https://doi.org/, whitespace, lowercase)
• Fuzzy PDF Matching (RapidFuzz token_set_ratio ≥ 85 against full-text repo)
• PRISMA SLR Audit Log: Dropped non-DOI rows immutably tracked in silver.lit_rejected
• Typed Union Schema: Harmonizes IEEE CSVs and ScienceDirect BibTeX exports
• Natural Key Upsert: Deduplicates within-source pagination clashes (source, source_id)
• Citation Backfill: Ingests OpenAlex cited-by metrics via local enrichment cache
• SHA-256 Hash Manifest: lit_source_files skips unmutated files for idempotency
• Raw Bibliographic Stores: lit_bib_entries (Elsevier & IEEE), lit_ieee_csv_rows
• Exact File Provenance: Preserves original search query provenance (lit_config)
From 8.5 KB JSON → 1.5 KB native binary
